text:
Maya (CS): Heads-up: Opal Finance asked for a short APAC QPS bump for an investor demo next Friday. They expect a spike to ~300 QPS for ~3 hours. Renewal is on the line.
Ethan (SE): What region/endpoints/models and CIDRs? Need to scope safely.
Maya (CS): Customer provided: ap-southeast-1 (SG). Endpoints: /v1/generate (gpt-redwood-8k) and /v1/embeddings. Current per-org QPS=60, requested=300. Window: 2024-11-15 09:00-12:00 SGT. IPs: 52.74.128.0/22, 13.250.0.0/16.
Liam (NetOps): We can add temporary edge allowlist entries and a timed policy. Need org ID and we'll require a signed addendum uploaded to support ticket before changing rules.
Maya (CS): Org: opal-finance-prod. We'll attach the addendum to the ticket and send API key via secure channel. They want auto-revoke.
Ava (Support): Opening support ticket for audit trail now. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/87642. Will attach the addendum and include rollback plan.
Ethan (SE): For safety, suggest a model override to reduce batching pressure: set /v1/generate -> gpt-redwood-8k:reduced-batch and enable prefix KV caching. Proposed config payload (sent to ops): 
```
{"org":"opal-finance-prod","region":"ap-southeast-1","qps":"300","window":"2024-11-15T09:00:00+08:00/2024-11-15T12:00:00+08:00","allowlist":["52.74.128.0/22","13.250.0.0/16"],"model_overrides":{"/v1/generate":"gpt-redwood-8k:reduced-batch"},"auto_revoke":"true"}
```
Liam (NetOps): OK. We'll apply as a temporary change with auto-revoke and set a safety fallback at 120 QPS if backend pressure rises. ETA ~20m to apply after ticket verification.
ops-bot: Change request created: #CR-9221; temp-qps-exception for opal-finance-prod/ap-southeast-1 assigned to @Liam.
Liam (NetOps): Applied: CIDRs added to APAC edge allowlist, routing policy updated, QPS rule live, fallback 120 QPS, auto-revoke scheduled 2024-11-15T12:05:00+08:00. Canary checks: 200 OK.
Ava (Support): Signed addendum and rollback notes uploaded to ticket 87642. Note added: "temp QPS exception granted per addendum; auto-revoke scheduled."
Maya (CS): I'll flag renewal team and attach the addendum. Customer will run stress tests tomorrow and report back.
Ethan (SE): I'll monitor latency, error rates, and quality via a small eval during the window to detect regressions from reduced-batch.
Liam (NetOps): Quick cost estimate for billing ops: ~USD 450 incremental for the 3-hour burst; will confirm final after the window.
ops-bot: Change request #CR-9221 status=applied auto-revoke=scheduled.
Maya (CS): Loop closed: customer confirmed demo success and said it materially improved renewal sentiment. Please append final cost numbers to ticket for renewal ops. :tada:
